tools.name: getDataSparsityCandidates
tools.description: Extracts custom entity and record fields specifically to allow the AI to perform data sparsity checks (looking for fields with extremely high null rates indicating abandonment).

tools.name: getWorkflowRedundancy
tools.description: Evaluates workflow history to identify workflows that trigger but yield no business value by tracking high abort or rejection rates.

tools.name: getLogicCollisions
tools.description: Maps the deployment records of active SuiteScripts and SuiteFlows to find logic collisions where a User Event Script and a Workflow overlap on the exact same record type.
